Royal Retreat: 4-Day Stay at Marriott Mena House:
Discover the Timeless Splendor of Egypt: A Four-Day Cultural Odyssey Embark on a captivating four-day journey through

, the heart of ancient Egypt, where the mystique of early civilization blends seamlessly with vibrant contemporary life. This specially curated adventure promises an intimate glimpse into the treasures of a land steeped in history and tradition. Here’s what to expect on this unforgettable tour:
Cairo’s Historical Enigma and Modern Pulse
: Begin your journey with a warm welcome at Cairo International Airport. Our dedicated representatives will ensure a smooth transfer to the historic
, located in the shadows of the majestic Pyramids of Giza. Here, each room offers a direct view of these ancient wonders—your first encounter with Egypt’s storied past.

Grand Egyptian Museum Exploration: Dive into the rich tapestry of Egyptian history at the Grand Egyptian Museum. Be enthralled by the legendary golden mask of King Tutankhamun and over 100,000 artifacts, from royal mummies to exquisite pottery and jewelry. The past comes alive in this modern marvel, with stunning views of the Giza pyramids adding an extra layer of awe to your visit.
, including the grand Cheops Pyramid. Visit the
to see the reconstructed ceremonial barque of Khufu and enjoy a mesmerizing camel ride through the desert, with the iconic pyramids and Sphinx as your backdrop.
Relish a special lunch at a felucca-themed restaurant managed by the Oberoi Group, offering splendid views over the Nile. This meal perfectly complements a day filled with discovery.
Leisure and Luxury at Mena House

Enjoy a day of leisure at the Mena House Hotel, which boasts a variety of activities and additional tours. Whether you choose to relax with the hotel’s luxurious amenities or continue your explorations, your day promises to be as enriching as it is relaxing.

After a leisurely breakfast and some final moments at the Mena House, our team will coordinate your transfer to Cairo International Airport. Depending on your flight schedule, we offer flexible arrangements to ensure your departure is as seamless as your arrival.
Prepare for extensive walking during tours, especially at archaeological sites.
Equip yourself with sunglasses, sunscreen, and a hat to enjoy your excursions under the Egyptian sun.
Dress modestly when visiting religious sites and be prepared to remove footwear when required.
: Wi-Fi may be limited at some locations, ensuring you have all necessary apps and information downloaded beforehand.
Be ready in your hotel lobby 15 minutes before your scheduled departure for each day’s adventures.
Upon arrival at Cairo International Airport, receive a warm welcome from our friendly representatives who will facilitate a smooth start to your journey in Egypt.
Spend your nights at the historic Mena House Hotel, offering breathtaking views of the Pyramids and providing a blend of luxury and tradition.
Enjoy the comfort of private, air-conditioned transfers to and from the airport and during all scheduled activities.
Benefit from the dedicated assistance of our guest relations team throughout your Cairo stay, ensuring your trip is enjoyable and hassle-free.
Embark on a journey through time with private guided tours of the Grand Egyptian Museum and the Great Giza Pyramids, ensuring a personalized and in-depth exploration of ancient Egyptian history.
Engage with the rich history and culture of Egypt through the knowledge and insight of our professional English-speaking guides.
Gain entry to all significant sites such as the Solar Boat Museum and the Pyramids area without the hassle of additional costs.
Enjoy daily breakfasts and select additional meals, featuring a range of Egyptian and international dishes to satisfy diverse palates.
Stay hydrated with bottled water supplied during any outings outside of your hotel.
Savor lunch in a unique felucca-themed restaurant managed by Oberoi, blending a traditional dining experience with modern culinary excellence.
All service charges and taxes are included, ensuring no hidden fees and a stress-free travel experience.

Royal Retreat: 4-Days Stay at Marriott Mena House
Arrival in Cairo – The Gateway to Ancient Wonders

Welcome to Egypt, the cradle of civilization! As you step off the plane at Cairo International Airport, feel the warm embrace of ancient history mixed with vibrant modern life. Our cheerful and experienced airport representatives will be there to greet you with open arms.

They’ll ensure your transfer to the Mena House Hotel is seamless and swift. Once you arrive, take a moment to settle into this historic hotel, nestled in the shadows of the awe-inspiring Pyramids. Your room offers a view like no other, gazing directly at these marvels of the ancient world.
Journey Through Time – Egyptian Museum and Giza Pyramids

Rise and shine with a scrumptious breakfast, gearing up for a day packed with adventure and discovery. First on the agenda is the Grand Egyptian Museum. Here, you’ll be transported back thousands of years as you wander through vast halls filled with relics of a bygone era, including the legendary golden mask of

. Amidst over 100,000 artifacts, you’ll find an array of pottery, jewelry, and even royal mummies! This museum, a modern architectural marvel, offers a stunning view of the Giza pyramids, adding to the epic experience. What more could you want?

For lunch, we’ve arranged something truly special—a meal at a felucca-themed restaurant managed by the renowned Oberoi Group. Enjoy your meal with a view that overlooks the Nile, providing a perfect midday break. Refreshed and refueled, it’s time to head to the Great
Pyramids. Stand in awe before the Cheops Pyramid, the grandest in the Giza pyramid complex, and explore the marvels of ancient engineering.

Visit the Solar Boat Museum to see the ceremonial solar barque of Khufu, and cap off your day with a thrilling camel ride through the sands of the Giza desert, with the pyramids silhouetted against the setting sun. As the day winds down, return to the Mena House to relax and recount the day’s wonders.
After another delightful breakfast, get ready for an exciting
! You’ll start your adventure with a visit to the

, an eerie yet fascinating underground tomb. Here, you’ll wander through a labyrinth of chambers adorned with a unique blend of Egyptian, Greek, and Roman architecture. The intricate carvings and statues make it a truly unforgettable experience.

, a massive red granite column that stands about 25 meters tall. It’s one of Alexandria’s most famous landmarks and a striking remnant of an ancient temple dedicated to the Greco-Egyptian deity Serapis.

, where you can dive into Alexandria’s rich history through over 40,000 artifacts. The museum’s collection includes stunning mosaics, delicate pottery, and impressive statues, offering a fascinating glimpse into the city’s cultural melting pot.
, a well-preserved site featuring semi-circular marble seating and intricate mosaic floors. Picture the ancient performances and gatherings that once took place here—it’s like stepping back in time.
In the afternoon, you’ll enjoy a sumptuous lunch at the

, known for its deluxe seafood menu. Start with a delicious shrimp soup and six types of fresh salads as appetizers. For the main course, savor the seafood rice packed with shrimp, crab, squid, and grouper fish. Choose between grilled or fried sea bass and tilapia, and enjoy grilled or fried shrimp and grilled squid. It’s a seafood lover’s paradise with flavors that will leave you wanting more.

, housed in a beautiful palace. The museum dazzles with its collection of opulent jewels and treasures from Egypt’s royal families. Each piece tells a story of the country’s regal history and exquisite craftsmanship.
Finally, take a leisurely stroll through the picturesque
. This stunning park is perfect for relaxing amidst lush gardens, elegant bridges, and serene coastal views. It’s a refreshing breath of air after a day of exploration.

After a full day of discovery, you’ll return to Cairo for a peaceful night at the Mena House. Whether you choose to relax or reminisce about your epic day in Alexandria, your evening is yours to enjoy.
Whether you choose to bask in the luxury of the hotel’s amenities or embark on another day of exploration, your time is yours to shape. Another peaceful night awaits you at the Mena House.
Enjoy a final leisurely breakfast at the Mena House. Depending on your departure time, take a moment to relax in your room or take one last stroll around the hotel grounds.
When it’s time to leave, our team will ensure your
is arranged, making your departure as smooth as your arrival. Should your flight be later in the day, we can make special arrangements to accommodate your schedule.

カイロ国際空港に到着すると、古代の歴史と現代の活気が融合したこの場所の雰囲気を感じることができます。私たちの親切で経験豊富な空港スタッフが、温かくお迎えし、
までの移動をスムーズにサポートします。
でゆっくりとくつろいでください。ピラミッドの壮大な影に囲まれたこのホテルでは、部屋からは古代の奇跡であるピラミッドの絶景が広がります。この特別な瞬間を存分に楽しみ、エジプトでの素晴らしい旅の始まりを感じましょう。
時を超えた旅 – エジプト考古学博物館とギザのピラミッド
朝食を楽しんだ後、冒険と発見が待つ一日が始まります。最初に訪れるのは、
グランド・エジプト博物館
ツタンカーメン王の黄金のマスク
など、古代の遺物が数多く展示されています。
といった美しい品々が、数千年の歴史を語りかけてきます。この現代的な建築の博物館からは、
の壮大な景色も一望でき、さらに印象的な体験を提供します。
オベロイグループが管理するフェルッカテーマのレストラン
で特別なひとときをお楽しみいただきます。ナイル川を見渡しながら、エジプトの味わいを堪能し、午後の探険に備えます。
は、その壮大さに圧倒されることでしょう。
を見学し、古代エジプトの技術の驚異を感じます。
ギザの砂漠をラクダで走り抜ける
冒険で一日を締めくくります。ピラミッドが夕日を背にシルエットとして浮かぶ中で、このエジプトの神秘的な瞬間を心に刻みます。
に戻り、一日をゆっくりと振り返りながらリラックスしてください。
アレクサンドリアへのワクワクする日帰り旅行
アレクサンドリアへの冒険
が始まります。最初に訪れるのは、
コム・エル・ショカファの地下墳墓
。ここでは、エジプト、ギリシャ、ローマの建築が見事に融合した地下の墓を探索します。複雑な彫刻や像が飾られ、忘れられない体験が待っています。
次に、アレクサンドリアの名所である
を見学。この25メートルもの高さを誇る赤い花崗岩の柱は、古代の神殿の名残で、ギリシャ・エジプトの神であるセラピスに捧げられています。
ギリシャ・ローマ博物館
でアレクサンドリアの豊かな歴史に触れます。博物館内には
が展示され、素晴らしいモザイクや繊細な陶器、印象的な像が、アレクサンドリアの文化的な融合を物語っています。
も訪れ、保存状態の良い半円形の大理石の座席や精緻なモザイクの床を見学。ここで行われた古代のパフォーマンスや集まりを想像して、まるで時を遡ったかのような気分になります。
フィッシュマーケット
で豪華なシーフード料理を楽しみます。前菜には美味しいエビのスープと6種類の新鮮なサラダを。メインには、エビ、カニ、イカ、グルーパーが入ったシーフードライスを味わい、グリルまたはフライドのスズキやティラピア、さらにエビやイカのグリル・フライをお楽しみいただけます。シーフード好きにはたまらないパラダイスです。
ロイヤルジュエリーミュージアム
を訪れ、美しい宮殿内に展示された豪華な宝石やエジプト王室の宝物を鑑賞。国の王族の歴史と精緻な工芸品が語りかけてきます。
を散策。美しい庭園や優雅な橋、静かな海の景色が広がるこの公園でリラックスし、探索の疲れを癒します。
充実した一日を過ごした後、
で静かな夜をお楽しみください。ホテルの施設でくつろぐも、アレクサンドリアでの素晴らしい日々を振り返るも、お好きなようにお過ごしください。
カイロに別れを告げて
での最後のゆったりとした朝食をお楽しみください。出発の時間に合わせて、お部屋でリラックスしたり、ホテルの敷地を最後に散策したりして、カイロでの素晴らしい滞在を締めくくりましょう。
出発の時間が来たら、私たちのスタッフが
までの移動を手配し、スムーズに空港へお送りいたします。もしフライトが午後以降の場合は、特別な手配を行い、スケジュールに合わせたご案内をいたします。
